scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @spellcaster/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spellcaster/shared && npm run build --workspace @spellcaster/server && npm run build --workspace @spellcaster/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @spellcaster/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @spellcaster/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @spellcaster/client
